description: Lists a page of milestones for a specific project, with optional filtering by state, title, search terms, or IID.

id.description: Project identifier: numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path in format 'namespace/project-name' (e.g., 'my-group/my-project'). Path must use forward slash / as separator. URL-encoding is handled automatically.
id.title: Id

iids.description: Return milestones with specific internal IDs. Ignored if include_ancestors is true.
iids.title: Iids[]

include_ancestors.description: Include milestones from parent groups. When true, iids parameter is ignored.
include_ancestors.title: Include Ancestors

search.description: Search milestones by title or description content.
search.title: Search

state.description: Filter by milestone state: 'active' for open milestones or 'closed' for completed ones.
state.title: State

title.description: Return milestones matching the exact title.
title.title: Title

updated_after.description: Return milestones updated on or after this time. Expected in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z).
updated_after.title: Updated After

updated_before.description: Return milestones updated on or before this time. Expected in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z).
updated_before.title: Updated Before

name: list_milestones

milestones.description: List of milestones for the project.
milestones.title: Milestones

due_date.description: Milestone due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
due_date.title: Due Date

expired.description: Whether the milestone has passed its due date.
expired.title: Expired

project_id.description: Project ID this milestone belongs to.
project_id.title: Project Id

start_date.description: Milestone start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
start_date.title: Start Date

web_url.description: Web URL to view the milestone.
web_url.title: Web Url
